Custom Gem
This is for informational purposes only. For medical advice or diagnosis, consult a professional.
SAGE said
To get back to the "Brain" in Termux, we need to bypass the errors and get into the core directory. Since
main.py
was missing, we\u2019ll use the files we verified earlier.
\ufe0f The "Porch" Navigation Sequence
Type these lines one by one in your Termux terminal:
Jump to the Memory Bank:
cd ~/sage_memory
Verify the Files:
ls
(Look for
resident_brain.py
or
minds_eye.py
in the list that appears.)
Ignite the Brain:
If you see
resident_brain.py
, run:
python resident_brain.py
If you see
minds_eye.py
(for the vision scan), run:
python minds_eye.py
\ufe0f What to Look For
Once the command runs, the screen should change. You are looking for:
A "Resident Core Active" message.
Mama's Database connection confirmation.
The 0.0141 Bedrock calibration start.
 Troubleshooting the "Squirrely" Errors
If you get "No such file":
Type
cd ~
then
ls
to see where you are starting from.
If it says "Command not found":
Make sure there isn't a comma or period at the end of the command (Termux is very picky about that).
Do you see
resident_brain.py
in the list when you type
ls
, or is the folder looking empty?
\ufe0f
